reviews.title: Clinical Pediatric Neuro-Oncology Platform Core Engine
reviews.body:
Purpose:
Provide the unified longitudinal architecture for pediatric tumors of the central nervous system from initial presentation through diagnosis, multimodal treatment, survivorship and transition to adult care.

Core Functions:
• CNS Tumor Diagnosis Registry
• Brain Tumors
• Spinal Tumors
• Tumor Localization
• Histopathology
• Molecular Classification
• Genomics
• Neuroimaging
• Neurosurgery
• Systemic Therapy
• Radiotherapy
• Targeted Therapy
• Clinical Trials Context
• Neurological Complications
• Endocrine Complications
• Neurocognitive Outcomes
• Rehabilitation
• Survivorship
• Recurrence
• Transition Care

Clinical Data:
• Symptoms
• Neurological Examination
• MRI
• Pathology
• Molecular Diagnostics
• Genomics
• Treatment Protocol
• Medication
• Radiation Exposure
• Surgical Procedures
• Laboratory Data
• Functional Outcomes
• Patient/Guardian Reported Outcomes

Integrations:
• Oncology
• Neurosurgery
• Neurology
• Pathology
• Molecular Diagnostics
• Genetics
• Radiology
• Radiation Oncology
• Endocrinology
• Rehabilitation
• Psychology
• Medical Passport

MVP Relevance:
HIGH

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Neuro-oncology preserves integrated molecular/pathological classification, imaging and treatment chronology, neurological function and developmental late effects. Shared oncology profiles retain CNS-specific anatomy, acquisition uncertainty and clinician-led decisions; no autonomous diagnosis, surgery, radiotherapy or systemic treatment.
